params.body:
## What

Each proposal on the Sources page says whether the source has a stake in what it says (Gentells Standard 0.18.0). This covers the scout's proposals, the publishers cited in posts, and a source's side panel. It reads **Independent**, **Has a stake** or **Writes about itself**, followed by the engine's one sentence why, and who changed it if a person did.

The team changes it in place: **Change** opens the three choices. The pipeline records the person and the time. A proposal without a rating says "Not rated yet", never "Independent".

## Checked

- `e2e/source-perspective.spec.js`:
  - the three readings, with the reason;
  - who changed it;
  - an unrated proposal;
  - a change, which sends `POST /sources/:id/perspective` with the choice.
- Full e2e, on top of the new Overview (#117): 62 of 62. The lint ratchet is unchanged (at its ceiling), and the build passes.
- A screenshot of the proposals with real ratings from the trial run was sent separately.

## Order

Merge after the pipeline change, which serves the fields and the route.
params.title: Sources: each proposal says whether it has a stake in what it says
